scenario: Final GC — Vuelta editions archetype, state through stage 14
note: Pre-race heads on the averaged Vuelta 2021-25 GC profile (mountain ~0.22 / rolling ~0.78). Live form as-of the run date. State through stage 9. THE RACE TURNED OVER: Pogacar abandoned on stage 8 (DNF on the flat run to Coquard's sprint) while leading by 3:34, and the classification he was sitting on top of collapsed into a genuine four-man contest. Mas leads after winning at Alto de Aitana on stage 9 ahead of Onley on the same time, with Roglic +1:18, Gall +1:39, Onley +2:20, then Carapaz +3:26, Skjelmose +3:55, Kuss +4:09 and Tejada +4:39. The book has Mas 2.30 and Roglic 2.50 as near co-favourites, Gall 5.00, Onley 7.00 — an open race where two days ago it was a procession. Rest day 2026-08-31; stage 10 is 2026-09-01. Stage 3 (Font-Romeu) was cancelled and is passed as a void stage. Rerun after each evening's seed_state_cache.py. State through stage 14 (Sierra de la Pandera): a 44-man escape took the stage — Brenner from Buitrago by a second, Cristian Rodriguez third — and behind it Mas attacked at 2.7 km to go, dropped Skjelmose and Onley, and finished together with Gall, Roglic and Carapaz after Roglic's own accelerations failed to shed him; the four crossed on the same time, with Kuss at 17 seconds and Onley/Omrzel at 35. Mas now leads Gall by 2:06, Roglic 2:10, Carapaz 4:24, Onley 5:44, Omrzel 6:14, Skjelmose 6:49; Cristian Rodriguez climbed to 8th at 7:01. The book after the stage has Mas 1.20 (69.5% devig), Roglic 6.00, Gall 9.00, Carapaz 34.0. Same-day odds snapshot (2026-09-05 17:20). Stage 3 cancelled, passed as a void stage.
